replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I haven’t used AI for math learning. I don’t see it as helpful for someone with no formal education in math. I don’t understand what stationary points are. I’ve never learned calculus or how to find derivatives. I can see graphs, but I can’t explain how to find the points where the slope is zero. It’s too technical and not something I’ve been exposed to.
